# Ending Support in 2029 - Microsoft Lifecycle | Microsoft Learn

![](/en-us/lifecycle/media/search.png) Please go [here](/en-us/lifecycle/products/) to search for your product's lifecycle.

The following list represents products retiring or reaching the end of support in 2029. Upon retirement or end of support, there will be no new security updates, non-security updates, free or paid assisted support options or online technical content updates. Go [here](/en-us/lifecycle/overview/product-end-of-support-overview) to learn about Fixed and Modern Lifecycle policies and service packs.

If you have any questions regarding support for a product, please contact your Microsoft Account Representative. If you need technical support, visit the [Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/contactus/?ws=support) website.

## Product Retirements

The following products, governed by the [Modern Policy](/en-us/lifecycle/policies/modern), will retire in 2029.

| Product | Retirement |
| --- | --- |
| [Access 2024](/en-us/lifecycle/products/access-2024?branch=live)[Excel 2024](/en-us/lifecycle/products/excel-2024?branch=live)[Office 2024](/en-us/lifecycle/products/office-2024?branch=live)[OneNote 2024](/en-us/lifecycle/products/onenote-2024?branch=live)[Outlook 2024](/en-us/lifecycle/products/outlook-2024?branch=live)[Project 2024](/en-us/lifecycle/products/project-2024?branch=live)[Visio 2024](/en-us/lifecycle/products/visio-2024?branch=live)[Word 2024](/en-us/lifecycle/products/word-2024?branch=live) | October 9, 2029 |
| [Dynamics GP](/en-us/lifecycle/products/dynamics-gp?branch=live) | December 31, 2029 |

## Products moving to Extended Support

The following products will be moving from Mainstream to Extended Support in 2029. Extended Support includes security updates at no cost, and paid non-security updates and support. Additionally, Microsoft will not accept requests for design changes or new features during the Extended Support phase.

| Product | End of Mainstream Support |
| --- | --- |
| [Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC 2024](/en-us/lifecycle/products/windows-11-iot-enterprise-ltsc-2024?branch=live)[Windows Server 2025](/en-us/lifecycle/products/windows-server-2025?branch=live)[Windows Server IoT 2025](/en-us/lifecycle/products/windows-server-iot-2025?branch=live) | October 9, 2029 |
